title: 第一卷 第30章 去他娘的乱世！
content_zh:
少女神情恍惚，继续开口，

    “我们原本就是想进城贩卖些野果野菜，多赚些星铜币，好买白丹和黑丹，让爹娘的身体好起来，也让我们的日子能宽裕一点。”

    少女声音沙哑，眼底掠过一丝转瞬即逝的憧憬，

    “我们这辈子最大的心愿，就是能住进镇城，不用再在村里担惊受怕，白天要防着魔物游荡，晚上要躲着妖邪作祟，哪怕能安稳睡一觉，都是奢望……”

    可这份憧憬很快便褪去，取而代之的是深入骨髓的痛苦与茫然。

    她缓缓抬眸，泪水再次汹涌的夺眶而出，看向陈渊的目光里满是绝望：

    “可我们只是好奇，那些贵人身上的衣服是什么料子，为何那般光鲜亮丽？

    就远远看了一眼……他们就活活打瞎了我爹娘的眼睛，最后还下了死手……”

    “呜呜呜呜……”

    少女再也忍不住，埋下头失声痛哭，哽咽的哭声里满是委屈与不甘，声音低得几乎听不清，

    “我爹娘身体本就不好，连白丹和净丹都买不起，身上早已被浊气污染，

    明明才三十多岁，看起来却像六十多岁的老人，

    本就没多少日子了……他们只是想多赚点钱，以后也给我买一件那样好看的衣服啊……”

    陈渊缄默不语，双拳死死攥紧，指节泛白，心中的怒火如同火山般即将喷发，那是足以焚烧整个大相帝国的滔天怒意。

    “那……”陈渊声音沙哑得厉害，涩声开口，“你不跟我们走，留在这里……”

    话音未落，陈渊脸色骤然剧变，瞳孔猛地收缩！

    “啊！你……你做什么？！”

    一旁警惕四周的陈昭宁和李伟闻声，也猛地回头，心脏骤然揪紧。

    下一瞬，他们眼睁睁看着少女趁着陈渊分神的刹那，猛地将自己的脖子，朝着陈渊手中那柄寒光凛冽的铁刺撞了过去！

    陈渊手中的铁刺时常被他打磨，那是何等锋利？

    不过瞬息之间，便径直穿透了少女的脖颈，鲜血瞬间喷涌而出，染红了陈渊的手臂。

    “你……你这是干什么？！！”

    陈渊心魂剧震，瞳孔骤缩，下意识想要抽回铁刺，却又怕加重少女的痛苦，只能僵在原地，声音里满是难以置信与慌乱。

    他手中的铁刺始终保持着战斗姿势，锋利的尖端朝向外侧，

    从未想过，眼前这个刚刚还在诉说委屈的少女，会突然选择以这样的方式结束自己的生命！

    她，竟是要自杀！

    “呃……嘻……嘻嘻······”

    少女的嘴角不断涌出鲜血，染红了她的衣襟，

    可她看着陈渊，嘴角却缓缓掀起一抹极淡的笑意，

    那笑意里没有痛苦，只有释然，

    “我……我要……记住……恩公兵器的味道……”

    “下辈子……我……还要为恩公……做牛做马……”

    “我……不能忘记……”

    她的声音虚弱得断断续续，漆黑的瞳孔渐渐涣散，却依旧带着一丝期盼，死死望着陈渊。

    “恩公……杀出去……荡平……这些……阻拦恩公的……肮脏……畜生！”

    这一句话，像是用尽了她最后一丝力气，从牙缝里艰难挤出。

    话音落下，少女的脑袋微微一歪，瞳孔彻底失去了神采，终是气绝身亡。

    她嘴角依旧挂着那抹释然的笑意，安安静静地倒在了陈渊的怀里。

    陈渊浑身一僵，大脑一片空白，只剩下无尽的震惊与滔天的怒火，胸口像是被巨石狠狠压住，喘不过气来。

    “不能拖太久了！”

    陈昭宁强压下心中的酸涩，急忙低声提醒，语气里满是焦急，
content_en:
The girl looked dazed and continued to speak,

"We originally wanted to go to the city to sell some wild fruits and vegetables, and earn more star copper coins, so that we can buy white pills and black pills, so that our parents can get better and our lives can be more comfortable."

The girl's voice was hoarse, and a fleeting look of longing flashed across her eyes.

"Our biggest wish in this life is to live in a small town and no longer have to worry about being in the village. We have to guard against monsters wandering around during the day and avoid evil spirits at night. Even if we can sleep peacefully, it is a luxury..."

But this longing soon faded away, replaced by bone-deep pain and confusion.

She slowly raised her eyes, tears bursting out of her eyes again, and her eyes looking at Chen Yuan were full of despair:

“But we are just curious, what are the materials of those noble people’s clothes, and why are they so bright and beautiful?

Just one look from afar... They beat my parents' eyes alive and then killed them..."

"Woooooooooo..."

The girl couldn't bear it anymore, she buried her head and cried bitterly. The choked cry was full of grievance and unwillingness, and her voice was so low that it was almost inaudible.

"My parents are not in good health. They can't even afford white elixirs and pure elixirs. Their bodies have long been polluted by turbid air.

Although he is only in his thirties, he looks like an old man in his sixties.

They don’t have much time left... They just want to make more money and buy me such a nice-looking dress in the future..."

Chen Yuan remained silent, his fists clenched tightly, his knuckles turned white, and the anger in his heart was like a volcano about to erupt. It was a huge anger that could burn the entire Prime Minister's Empire.

"Then..." Chen Yuan's voice was extremely hoarse and he spoke in a solemn voice, "If you don't come with us, stay here..."

Before he finished speaking, Chen Yuan's expression suddenly changed and his pupils shrank suddenly!

"Ah! What...what are you doing?!"

Chen Zhaoning and Li Wei, who were watching their surroundings, heard the sound and turned around suddenly, their hearts tightening suddenly.

The next moment, they watched helplessly as the girl took advantage of Chen Yuan's distraction to slam her neck into the cold iron thorn in Chen Yuan's hand!

The iron thorns in Chen Yuan's hands were often polished by him. How sharp were they?

But in an instant, it penetrated straight through the girl's neck, and blood spurted out instantly, staining Chen Yuan's arm red.

"You...what are you doing?!!"

Chen Yuan's heart was shaken, his pupils shrank suddenly, and he subconsciously wanted to withdraw the iron thorn, but he was afraid of aggravating the girl's pain, so he could only freeze in place, his voice full of disbelief and panic.

The iron thorn in his hand always maintained a fighting posture, with the sharp tip facing outward.

I never thought that the girl in front of me who was just complaining about her grievances would suddenly choose to end her life in this way!

She actually wanted to commit suicide!

"Uh... hee... hee hee..."

Blood kept pouring out of the corners of the girl's mouth, staining her clothes red.

But when she looked at Chen Yuan, a faint smile slowly appeared at the corner of her mouth.

There was no pain in that smile, only relief.

"I...I want...to remember...the smell of my benefactor's weapons..."

"In the next life...I...will still work for my benefactor...as a cow and a horse..."

"I...can't forget..."

Her voice was weak and intermittent, and her dark pupils gradually became dilated, but she still looked at Chen Yuan with a trace of hope.

"My benefactor...kill him out...and wipe out...these...filthy...bastards...who are blocking my benefactor!"

This sentence seemed to have been squeezed out from between her teeth with the last bit of her strength.

After the words fell, the girl's head tilted slightly, her pupils completely lost their luster, and she finally died.

The relieved smile still hung on her lips, and she fell quietly into Chen Yuan's arms.

Chen Yuan's body froze, his mind went blank, leaving only endless shock and monstrous anger. His chest seemed to be pressed hard by a huge boulder, and he couldn't breathe.

"Can't wait too long!"

Chen Zhaoning suppressed the sourness in his heart and hurriedly whispered a reminder, his tone full of anxiety.
